subject: T011 OpenAPI v1 contract independent proof

contract.idempotency: Idempotency-Key is required on x-idempotent operations
contract.optimistic_locking: If-Match is required on x-optimistic-lock operations

validator.engine: yaml 2.9.0 parser plus deterministic OpenAPI structural/example/ref checks

checks.name: OpenAPI dialect
checks.detail: OpenAPI 3.1.0 and JSON Schema draft 2020-12 dialect are explicit.

checks.name: planned operation inventory
checks.detail: Public, reader, editorial/publisher, media, taxonomy, offline, provenance and optional SIWE operations are present under /api/v1.

checks.name: security and concurrency
checks.detail: OIDC bearer and BFF cookie schemes are declared; Idempotency-Key and If-Match requirements are linted.

checks.name: Problem Details catalog
checks.detail: All stable statuses 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 429 use application/problem+json responses with stable codes and examples.

checks.name: examples
checks.detail: Every request body and successful response with content has an example; 17 request bodies are checked.

checks.name: canonical ContentDocument ref
checks.detail: The OpenAPI component references ./content-document.schema.json and the file is present and parseable on the implementation branch.

residual_risks: T010 must prove runtime validator parity and T012 must generate the TypeScript client from this contract.
OpenAPI security and optimistic-lock declarations are contract requirements; runtime enforcement remains later implementation scope.
SIWE is optional and never grants editor/publisher authority.
next_gate: Run repository CI/Security and current-head review, then use expected-head human merge authority; keep T011 unchecked until main read-back.
